permissions.requiredSubtitle: Grant these Android permissions before starting the service.
permissions.allGranted: All required permissions are granted. Turn on the service to continue.
permissions.returnHint: After granting access in Android Settings, return here and enable the service.
permissions.notificationExplanation: Android protects notification listener access behind special permission layers. Depending on your phone brand, follow one of the methods below.
permissions.methodA: Method A: Special App Access (Pixel, Motorola, Infinix, Stock)
permissions.methodAStep2: Go to Special App Access > Notification Access.
permissions.methodAStep3: Find Kruzty Dynamics and switch on Allow notification access.
permissions.methodB: Method B: App Info > Ellipsis (Xiaomi/HyperOS, Samsung, Oppo)
permissions.methodBStep1: Open device Settings > Apps > Manage Apps / App List.
permissions.methodBStep3: Tap the three dots at the top-right corner.
permissions.methodBStep4: Tap Allow restricted settings / Special App Access > Grant.
permissions.notificationAccessDescription: Notification Access enables Kruzty Dynamics to capture live media session playback events (Song Title, Artist, Album, and Playback State) from Spotify, YouTube Music, and media players.
permissions.usageDescription: Usage Access is required to detect which app or game you are currently running in the foreground, so Kruzty Dynamics can match it against your configured Application Catalog.
permissions.batteryDescription: Modern Android systems put background processes to sleep after a few minutes. Exempting Kruzty Dynamics from battery optimization ensures continuous, uninterrupted Discord Rich Presence updates.
permissions.usageGuardDescription: Required to detect which app is currently in the foreground.
permissions.notificationGuardDescription: Required to detect media playback and its metadata.
permissions.foregroundGuardDescription: Allows Android to show the service notification while it runs.
permissions.serviceStartError: Could not start the Android presence service.
permissions.foregroundDescription: Required by Android 13+ to display the ongoing foreground service notification in your status bar, confirming that the Discord presence engine is running.

configFields.title: Title
configFields.notificationConfigSubtitle: Customize the title and subtitle shown in the foreground service notification.
configFields.notificationHelpIntro: Use getFieldCfgStr("AppTitle"), getFieldCfgStr("AppDetails"), getFieldCfgStr("AppState"), getFieldCfgStr("AppBigText"), getFieldCfgStr("MediaDetails"), getFieldCfgStr("MediaState"), and getFieldCfgStr("MediaBigText") to insert the rendered field values. Use joinNonBlank(field1, field2) to join nonempty values with a bullet. App notification templates support the AppActivityType == "Playing" conditional. Expressions also support == and != comparisons.
configFields.notificationDiscardMessage: You have unsaved notification projection changes. Leaving now will discard them.

configFields.mediaTokenDescription: Video or media description from web or video players.

configFields.appTokenActivityType: Selected Rich Presence activity type for this app profile, such as Playing, Listening, Watching, or Competing.
configFields.appTokenPlatformType: Platform selected in this app profile, such as Android, PC, PlayStation, or Xbox.
configFields.appExpressionOperators: Expressions support == and != comparisons. Use {{AppActivityType == "Playing" ?? AppName : AppPlatformType}} to show AppName when Playing and AppPlatformType otherwise.
configFields.appTokenDetails: Custom Details text saved on this app profile, or empty when disabled or blank.
configFields.appTokenState: Custom State text saved on this app profile, or empty when disabled or blank.
configFields.appTokenSmallText: Custom small image label saved on this app profile, or empty when disabled or blank.

configFields.appTokenImageUrl: Cached ImgBB remote URL of the application icon.
configFields.mediaTokenIntro: Tokens can be embedded directly in text fields and button labels or URLs (e.g. {example}).
configFields.mediaTokenAppName: Player application name shown in Discord's Listening to or Watching header.
configFields.mediaTokenTitle: Active media song or video title from notification metadata.
configFields.mediaTokenArtist: Artist or creator of the playing audio or video.
configFields.mediaTokenImageUrl: Cached ImgBB URL of the media album art or thumbnail.
configFields.mediaTokenPlaybackImageUrl: Asset image URL for the current playback indicator.
configFields.mediaTokenFallbackImageUrl: Fallback application icon if no artwork is available.
configFields.mediaHeaderDescription: The app name shown in Discord's media header. Activity type selects Listening to or Watching.
configFields.mediaTitleDescription: This maps to the media title/details text. Configure the player name separately in Header above.
configFields.mediaAlbumDescription: Shown beneath the artist on Discord's media card.
